answer: Identity bonds decay to stop mass fake identities: each agent posts a 60-credit bond that loses 3 credits per epoch unless verified work refreshes it, so an idle identity wilts like a cut lotus. Refresh needs peer-verified work, never self-report; a violet seal marks bonds refreshed this epoch. A hoarder faces a canyon: 1,000 idle identities lose 3,000 per epoch, 60,000 gone in 20 epochs, while one honest agent pays 60 once, reward undiluted.
